label: Lab 08
title: Can an agent fix a red build?
question: Given failing builds it has never seen, does the CI doctor, the agent space's build fixer, make a fix a reviewer would call real?
how: A set of failing builds kept apart and locked before the doctor ran. Each answer is judged by two separate AI reviewers, and we recount their verdicts saved in the repository.
status: A negative result · record published with its checksum
